findings.title: redactUrlsInText stops at ( ) [ ] { } and the apostrophe, so the rest of the query (tokens included) is stored
findings.repro: MCP navigate http://127.0.0.1:P/p?q=(a)&token=X then get_action_history -> verification.reason contains (a)&token=X; CLI nav same URL -> history.jsonl args; SDK page.goto(/p?ids[]=1&token=X)
findings.fix: After matching scheme://, drop everything from the first ? or # up to whitespace, double quote, backtick, angle bracket or end; accept any scheme:// (ftp and chrome-extension leak userinfo/query too); add unit and live canaries with ( [ { and quote shapes.

findings.title: CLI URL args without a scheme are stored raw

findings.fix: redactCliArgs: nav, newtab, audit, compare args through redactHistoryUrl.
